comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Yeah, sorry, my bad. I think I added Stone by mistake while checking collection levels off the DB here (though it can be found in the NA East Coast landing, which might also have confused me). Revised statement:

As of chapter 2: Cross a Continent, there's now an entrance to a new inland zone here in the southwest corner, via a Large Boulder (across from the Large Tree) which leads to the Niagara River Basin (accessible even without a discovery there).

Collection: Cranberries, Large Leaves (R6), Lumber, White Ore (R2), Vegetable Oil (R1)
Procurement: Mushrooms (R1), Berries (R1), Exotic Fruit (R7), Earthworms (R6)
Misc.: Common Grass
Search: Feathered Headband, Feathered Bonnet, Dull Longsword, Steel-wire Hunting net, Wood spear, Iron Axe, Dull scimitar, Famous explorer's notes, Rusty short sword

I'm unclear on the collection ranks for lumber/cranberries, but they definitely showed up with R9 Collection; they may also appear at much lower levels.
